Alex Kim: hey @people-ops :wave: quick q — I converted from contractor to FT on 2024-01-25. Missed the initial enrollment cutoff. When do my 401k and HSA elections take effect? Is the employer match prorated for the partial pay period? Any way to apply match to contractor pay?
Maria Gonzales: congrats! Our standard: benefits effective first of the month after 30 days of FT service. With FT start 2024-01-25, effective date is 2024-03-01. Employer match only applies to eligible employee wages paid after your benefits effective date (so contractor earnings are not eligible).
Maria Gonzales: payroll cutoff windows (PT): 5th 23:59 => affects pay dates on/after 15th; 20th 23:59 => affects pay dates on/after end-of-month. To have deductions on a pay that posts 2/28 you would have needed to enroll by 2024-02-20 23:59 PT. Since effective date is 3/1, first pre-tax HSA and 401(k) deferrals should appear on the first paycheck after 3/1 (likely 3/15).
Alex Kim: ok — any path to request retroactive match for contractor invoices? I can provide invoices/pay records.
Maria Gonzales: generally no. Exception only if there was an admin error and you should have been paid as W-2; in that case submit a ticket to payroll + benefits with docs and we can evaluate. Otherwise match applies going forward.
Charlie Patel: FWIW I converted mid-month last quarter and had the same flow; payroll processed the change quickly once benefits was filed.
Alex Kim: thanks. Any forms to fill for the conversion flow?
Maria Gonzales: fill the "Conversion Enrollment" form: https://redwood/hr/forms/conversion-enrollment. Choose 401(k) deferral % and HSA election. Deadline to guarantee 3/1 coverage is 2024-02-28 23:59 PT. After you submit I can flag payroll to double-check.
Alex Kim: submitted, thanks! :thumbsup:
Benefits Bot: Enrollment received for Alex Kim. Ref: ENR-20240215-789.
